'''Joodrudda''' was a barren, nearly uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|world]] located on the [[Tingel Route]], just outside the borders of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Its only point of interest was a [[Lungru's summer palace|sprawling palace]] constructed hundreds of years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by a clan of eccentric [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="TEA" />
